posts.name: CZ
posts.text:
Why are crypto prices down?

No one knows for sure. Correlation does not prove causation. Here are some potential reasons.

Money shifting to the Anthropic IPO: https://t.co/4WXOMfH9Th

ETF outflows: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.9 billion in outflows over seven trading sessions through November 13. Ether funds also saw withdrawals. https://t.co/RxhYaaOMAU

Security fears: the Binance hack, iPhone-linked crypto wallets drained, Chrome exploit, Microsoft down. These security incidents could make some people less willing to keep funds in crypto.

Hot U.S. inflation has raised expectations of another Fed rate hike. Higher yields and a stronger dollar can weigh on "riskier assets" such as crypto.

Political uncertainty: Midterm results have raised concerns about potentially stricter U.S. crypto policy.

No, Binance did not sell crypto.

I bought crypto in the past few days, as I got some stablecoins recently. (maybe this is the cause 🤣)

Mid-long term, crypto will continue to grow.

Views are my own. Not financial advice. 

For future reference, price of BTC hit a low of $62,006 today.
posts.textZh:
为什么加密货币价格在下跌？

没有人确切知道。相关性并不等于因果关系。以下是一些可能的原因。

资金转向 Anthropic 的 IPO：https://t.co/4WXOMfH9Th

ETF 资金流出：截至 11 月 13 日，美国现货比特币 ETF 在七个交易日内流出约 19 亿美元。以太坊基金也出现了赎回。https://t.co/RxhYaaOMAU

安全担忧：币安遭黑客攻击、与 iPhone 关联的加密钱包被抽空、Chrome 漏洞、微软宕机。这些安全事件可能让一些人更不愿意把资金留在加密货币里。

美国通胀偏热，提高了美联储再次加息的预期。更高的收益率和更强的美元可能压制加密货币这类“风险资产”。

政治不确定性：中期选举结果引发了人们对美国加密政策可能收紧的担忧。

不，币安没有抛售加密货币。

我过去几天买了加密货币，因为最近拿到了一些稳定币。（也许这就是原因 🤣）

中长期来看，加密货币将继续增长。

以上仅为我个人观点，不构成财务建议。

供日后参考：比特币价格今天最低触及 $62,006。

posts.name: Matt Cole
posts.text:
My wife went to a branch of one of the largest U.S. banks today to withdraw cash. Staff told her they’d run out of cash because so many people were withdrawing over cyber fears.

We’ve never had that happen before. An interesting window into the level of fear out there.
posts.textZh:
我妻子今天去美国最大银行之一的网点取现。工作人员告诉她，现金已经取完了，因为很多人出于网络安全担忧在取钱。

我们以前从未遇到过这种情况。这是观察外界恐慌程度的一个有意思窗口。

posts.name: Matt Cole
posts.text:
Our nation, America, was founded on the conviction that liberty is an inherent right and government exists to protect it. Defending that heritage as technology grows more powerful will be one of the defining political fights of our generation.

Freedom in money, speech and intelligence will shape the next chapter for America. Bitcoin, open source AI and encrypted communication can put extraordinary power in individual hands, helping us build a future that is both more free and more secure. We owe our children both the liberties we inherited and the tools to defend them.

The Finney Foundation is taking on this fight. Its mission deserves our financial support and, more importantly, our time and energy. Grateful for this team’s work and leadership, and proud to support them. 

🇺🇸
posts.textZh:
我们的国家美国，建立在自由是与生俱来的权利、政府的存在是为了保护这一权利的信念之上。在技术日益强大的时代捍卫这一传统，将成为我们这一代人决定性的政治斗争之一。

货币、言论和智能方面的自由，将塑造美国的下一篇章。比特币、开源 AI 和加密通信可以把非凡的力量交到个人手中，帮助我们建设一个既更自由也更安全的未来。我们欠孩子们的，不仅是我们继承来的自由，还有捍卫这些自由的工具。

Finney Foundation 正在承担这场斗争。它的使命值得我们的资金支持，更重要的是值得我们投入时间和精力。感谢这个团队的工作和领导，也自豪能支持他们。

🇺🇸
